field(s): purchases: order_id, customer_id, product_id, category, day
meaning: Order, customer, product, category; day 0–179 of the window
Ordered size as an index 0–5 (S-, S, M, L, XL, XXL) / label
none, size_smaller, size_larger or other (label source; 4% of size reasons carry the wrong direction)
Prior-period history; usual_size = mean size of prior orders that were kept (blank for new customers)

field(s): products: brand, fabric, price_inr, launch_day, avg_rating_snapshot
meaning: Product attributes; launch_day ≥ 0 means launched inside the window (no reviews at snapshot)

field(s): reviews: product_id, day, review_text, fit_tag, rating
meaning: Review text (English / Hinglish), the platform's optional fit tag (small / ok / large) on ≈ 8% of reviews; all posted before the window
Public labelled fit reviews (stand-in for ModCloth)
HIDDEN truth: body-vs-garment gap, return draw, true return reason, body size, product offset, perceived fit (digital twin only)
